claims.nodeLabel: 10 U.S.C. 119 - Special Access Programs: Congressional Oversight
claims.sourceText: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, 10 U.S.C. 119, 'Special access programs: congressional oversight' (text in effect on 20 August 2026) - https://uscode.house.gov/view.xhtml?req=granuleid:USC-prelim-title10-section119&num=0&edition=prelim ; and S. 2103, Intelligence Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, as reported 22 June 2023 - https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/BILLS-118s2103rs/html/BILLS-118s2103rs.htm
claims.text: Section 119 has not been amended since 2001. The source credit runs Pub. L. 100-180 (1987), Pub. L. 101-510 (1990), Pub. L. 104-106 (1996), Pub. L. 106-65 (1999), Pub. L. 107-107 (2001), and stops. The Senate Intelligence Committee's Sec. 1103 of S. 2103 as reported in June 2023, 'Modification of congressional oversight of special access programs', would have been the first amendment in twenty-two years; it does not appear in the Senate-passed Division M and Section 119 as it stands today shows no 2023 or 2024 amendment.

claims.nodeLabel: IAA FY2024 Sec. 1102 - contractor turn-in of 'non-earth origin or exotic' UAP material
claims.sourceText: S. 2103, Intelligence Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, as reported 22 June 2023 - https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/BILLS-118s2103rs/html/BILLS-118s2103rs.htm (table of contents, Title XI) ; compared against Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, 'Intelligence Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, Division M of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024, as passed by the Senate on July 27, 2023', 9 August 2023 - https://www.intelligence.senate.gov/2023/08/09/legislation-intelligence-authorization-act-fiscal-year-2024-division-m-national-defense/ (posted PDF: https://www.intelligence.senate.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/sites-default-files-legislation-bills-118s2226es.pdf)
claims.text: RENUMBERING AND ATTRITION BETWEEN COMMITTEE AND FLOOR. In S. 2103 as reported by the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence on 22 June 2023, Title XI--Other Matters contained four sections: 'Sec. 1101. Modification of reporting requirement for All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office.'; 'Sec. 1102. Modifications to notification on the provision of defense sensitive [support]'; 'Sec. 1103. Modification of congressional oversight of special access programs.'; and 'Sec. 1104. Funding limitations relating to unidentified anomalous phenomena.' The engrossed Division M carries only the first and the last of these, renumbered 1101 and 1102. Two provisions were therefore dropped between committee and the Senate-passed text, and one of the two dropped provisions was a direct amendment to the congressional oversight regime for special access programs. That is a soft joint the board did not previously have: the same intelligence committee that wrote the UAP funding limitation also wrote a special access program oversight amendment alongside it, and only the funding limitation survived to the floor text.

claims.text: 'No criminal or civil action may lie or be maintained in any Federal or State court against any person for receiving material or information described in subsection (d) if that person complies with the notification and reporting provisions.'

claims.nodeLabel: S. 2103 Sec. 1104 - SSCI contractor disclosure and immunity provision (stripped)
claims.sourceText: S. 2103 Sec. 1104(d), as reported by the Senate Select Committee on Intelligence, 22 June 2023
claims.text: Contractors possessing government-derived UAP material must notify the DNI within 60 days and within 180 days make available 'a comprehensive list of all non-earth origin or exotic unidentified anomalous phenomena material.'

a.label: S. 2103 Sec. 1104 - SSCI contractor disclosure and immunity provision (stripped)

edges.label: The provision named derived propulsion work as a defunding category
edges.note: Sec. 1104(c) targets propulsion 'based on or derived from or inspired by inspection, analysis, or reverse engineering of recovered unidentified anomalous phenomena craft or materials,' and any aerospace craft using propulsion other than chemical, solar or electric ion thrust.

a.label: S. 2103 Sec. 1104 - SSCI contractor disclosure and immunity provision (stripped)

b.label: FY2024 NDAA sec. 1687 - Limitation on Use of Funds for Certain Unreported Programs

edges.label: Only the funding limitation and the IR&D restriction survived into law
edges.note: Sec. 1687 and Sec. 7343 of Public Law 118-31 carry forward the funding cutoff and the IR&D clause from the Senate provision; the contractor disclosure, inventory and immunity subsections were removed.

a.label: S. 2103 Sec. 1104 - SSCI contractor disclosure and immunity provision (stripped)

edges.label: SSCI would have compelled contractors to list all 'non-earth origin or exotic' material they hold, with immunity
edges.note: S. 2103 Sec. 1104(d)-(e), reported unanimously on 22 June 2023, required notification to the DNI within 60 days and production within 180, and barred any criminal or civil action against a complying holder. The phrase 'non-earth origin' does not appear in the enacted law.
